brief: The 6-step client onboarding flow that cut churn by 40%.

slots.headline: The onboarding flow that cut client churn by 40%
slots.swipeNote: Swipe to see the 6 steps to zero churn

slots.title: Send the pre-work questionnaire
slots.body: Before the kickoff, send a short questionnaire to clarify goals, stakeholders, and existing pain points. It transforms the first call from awkward small talk into a working session.

slots.title: Run a ruthless kickoff call
slots.body: Use the first meeting to confirm success metrics, timelines, and communication rhythms. Leave with a shared document everyone has actually read.

slots.title: Deliver a quick win first
slots.body: Identify one high-impact, low-effort improvement you can ship within the first ten days. Early momentum builds trust faster than any roadmap.

slots.title: Set up a shared dashboard
slots.body: Give clients real-time visibility into progress with a simple project dashboard. Transparency replaces anxious check-in emails before they ever start.

slots.title: Schedule proactive check-in rituals
slots.body: Book recurring 15-minute pulse calls instead of waiting for problems to surface. Consistency signals that you are invested in their outcomes.

slots.title: Launch a 30-day review cycle
slots.body: At the one-month mark, review wins, blockers, and next quarter's priorities. Turning feedback into action is how relationships last.
